note: Bamboo wall sconce, hardwired: a 18 x 23 cm teardrop of flat bamboo strips, widest below the middle, over a plain slate-blue fabric liner, hung on a cord from a solid-wood wall arm, E26. Sourced 2026-09-14 from listing 1005006439147774 (seller Eternal Light Store; 4.6 from 11 reviews, 193 sold), whose spec table reads Voltage 220 V, Base Type E26, Power Source AC, Is Include PCBA N, Is Bulbs Included No, Body Material BAMBOO, Material Wood - and whose own gallery sheet prints "E26 Socket, Max 60W, 110-120V" with "Recommend Bulbs, E26 Base". Straight solid-wood arm on a square wood backplate (about 12 cm; arm about 18 cm), the shade hung from the arm on a cord. Four shades on the listing (A woven globe stock 3 - NOT built, rule 4; B, C, D stock 199-200). Competitor set is the amazon.ca wall-sconce basket read 2026-09-13 for the cone sconce; it is category-level and applies to any wall sconce in the range, so it is reused here verbatim rather than re-read. Rule 18: a teardrop over a plain liner on a wood arm - not the cone, not the cage (B, wider and rounded over a printed liner), not the lattice (D, square), and not the slatted pear pendant, which is a ceiling fixture with no liner.

costSource: AliExpress Canadian-gateway per-SKU price from window._d_c_ PRICE.skuPriceInfoMap on listing 1005006439147774, SKU 200000795:175#C;249:200006305#No light bulb, read 2026-09-14: salePriceString C$41.17 against originalPrice C$43.96. That is a 6% gap - a promotion, not rounding - so RULE 22 makes the LIST price the cost basis and itemCostCad is 43.96, NOT 41.17. Not yet cross-checked against a DSers stable cost: the product does not exist in Shopify or DSers yet, and the DSers reading is the mapping step, not the sourcing step.
dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price.
verdict: Priced at CA$89.99, CA$4.61 over the CA$85.375 amazon.ca wall-sconce band median and CA$8.19 under the CA$98.18 RULE 2 ceiling - the cone sconce's price, on the cone's band. Contributes CA$27.81/unit on the wholesale basis (7% MFN on value for duty) at the LIST cost of C$43.96 with free freight, against the CA$16.23 floor - clears by CA$11.58. Rule 22: the page sells at C$41.17, a 6% gap under the C$43.96 originalPrice, so the LIST price is the cost basis and the sale price is upside the model does not count. Per-SKU stock 200 clears rule 4 (>= 25). Rule 18: a teardrop over a plain liner on a wood arm - not the cone, not the cage (B, wider and rounded over a printed liner), not the lattice (D, square), and not the slatted pear pendant, which is a ceiling fixture with no liner. VOLTAGE: the spec table's Voltage field reads 220 V; the fixture is a bare E26 socket and cord with PCBA N, which is the case the 220 V hold was lifted for on 2026-09-14, and this seller's own gallery sheet prints 110-120 V, so the copy states 110-120 V from the seller's sheet.
supplierSkuNote: 'C' is the seller's lampshade-colour swatch letter and describes nothing about the product - the shade is a 18 x 23 cm teardrop of flat bamboo strips, widest below the middle, over a plain slate-blue fabric liner. Recorded so a human can find the row in DSers.

retailNote: Priced 2026-09-14 at CA$89.99, the cone sconce's price on the shared wall-sconce band: slightly ABOVE the CA$85.375 median and CA$8.19 under the CA$98.18 ceiling. At C$43.96 list with free freight this offer files 14.84 at CA$74.99 (under the 16.23 floor) but clears at CA$79.99 (19.16) and CA$84.99 (23.49), so it does not NEED CA$89.99 the way the cone does; it takes it so the three arm sconces and the cone sit at one price on one band, and because a reviewless store should not lead its band. If the cone ever moves, these move with it.
